{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the [[Ciutric Offensive]] of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a '''pirate captain''' betrayed [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] fleeing from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. As a results of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain's]] actions, the Separatists were intercepted and [[Assault on Vardoss IV|defeated]] in the [[Vardoss system/Legends|Vardoss system]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]].
